title: Möbius disjointness conjecture for Furstenberg's flow on $\mathbb{T}^ω$ in short intervals
summary: Furstenberg's flow on the infinite-dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^ω$ is defined by \[ T (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_ν, \ldots) = (x_1 + α, x_2 + h(x_1), \ldots, x_ν+ h(x_1 + (ν-2)β), \ldots) \] with $α\in \mathbb{R}$ satisfying certain diophantine conditions, $β\in \mathbb{R}\backslash\mathbb{Q},$ and $h: \mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ being $1$-periodic and analytic. This flow is irregular in the sense that its Birkhoff average does not exist for some $x\in \mathbb{T}^ω$, and it is a generalization of Furstenberg's irregular flow on $\mathbb{T}^2$.
